command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Collection lookup and the selected CPU fields fit the test, but fixed `system`, operator-entered PROC_ID, `-k`, `jq -r` and `2>/dev/null` can conceal target, null/type and transport errors.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With trusted TLS, select one exact member URI from the intended System Processors collection, GET it once, retain HTTP/parser failures, validate @odata.id/Id and typed CPU fields, then export a redacted record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The single processor-member read and 15/10 timing remain; no System ID, processor ID, model, part number or healthy status is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a link-aware member validator that keeps status, headers and parse diagnostics alongside approved CPU fields.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates fixed identity, arbitrary instance input, TLS bypass and error suppression while adding exact URI/Id and JSON type validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Provides depth for one collection-linked processor; completeness across every processor remains the preceding collection case's responsibility.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A healthy Redfish status does not test CPU performance, machine-check behavior, socket electrical health or workload stability.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK is equivalent if it follows the advertised member URI, validates identity and retains failures. Host CPU tools may corroborate model/socket data but cannot replace the management-resource member contract.
expected_evidence: Immutable BMC/System identity, firmware and Processor schema
HTTP status/content type and restricted raw response hash
Requested URI, returned @odata.id and Id agreement

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master item, instance path and GET consistently describe one processor member query. DeepSeek's fixed IDs and suppressed errors are implementation deficiencies, not contradictory source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The member-read purpose and required fields are identifiable; the standard secure Redfish/member-schema configuration is sufficient.

review_improvement: Replaces a free-form, error-suppressing instance read with a collection-proven, type-safe processor record and auditable failure evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A processor Id typed by an operator is not evidence of collection membership, and Redfish implementations may expose multiple Systems or non-CPU Processor resources. Exact URI provenance and ProcessorType are therefore part of identity. Flattening fields through `jq -r` makes null, missing and string values deceptively similar, while discarded stderr can turn TLS or JSON failures into empty output. A correct member check preserves those distinctions and redacts part/topology information before export.
